questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.q: Purification of colloids is done by
options: dialysis
peptisation
electrophoresis
coagulation
questions.solution: Colloidal solutions are prepared by peptisation method, whereas coagulation and electrophoresis are the properties of colloidal solution.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.q: Which of the following statements is incorrect?
options: On prolonged dialysis colloid becomes stable.
$\mathrm{AgNO}_3$ in excess $\mathrm{KI}$ forms negative colloid.
$\mathrm{AgNO}_3$ in excess $\mathrm{KI}$ forms positive colloid.
Medicines work best in colloidal form because of greater surface area.
questions.solution: Mixing $\mathrm{AgNO}_3$ in excess KI forms negatively charged colloid.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.q: Paints and hair creams are respectively
options: sol and emulsion
aerosol and foam
emulsion and sol
foam and gel.
questions.solution:
Paints - Solid in liquid type colloid
Hair cream - Liquid in liquid type colloid

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.q: The coagulation of $200 \mathrm{~mL}$ of a positive colloid took place when $0.73 \mathrm{~g} \mathrm{HCl}$ was added to it without changing the volume much. The flocculation value of $\mathrm{HCl}$ for the colloid is
questions.solution:
: $200 \mathrm{~mL}$ of the sol required $=0.73 \mathrm{~g} \mathrm{HCl}=\frac{0.73}{36.5}=0.02 \mathrm{~mol}=20 \mathrm{mmol}\therefore \quad 1000 \mathrm{~mL}(1 \mathrm{~L})$ of the sol will require
$=\frac{20}{200} \times 1000=100 \mathrm{mmol}$
Thus, the flocculation value of $\mathrm{HCl}$ for the colloid is 100 .

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.q:
Assertion : $\mathrm{Fe}(\mathrm{OH})_3$ and $\mathrm{As}_2 \mathrm{~S}_3$ colloidal sols on mixing precipitate.
Reason : $\mathrm{Fe}(\mathrm{OH})_3$ and $\mathrm{As}_2 \mathrm{~S}_3$ combine and form precipitate of new composition.
options: If both assertion and reason are true and reason is the correct explanation of assertion.
If both assertion and reason are true but reason is not the correct explanation of assertion.
If assertion is true but reason is false.
If both assertion and reason are false.
questions.solution: On mixing $\mathrm{Fe}(\mathrm{OH})_3$ (+ve sol) and $\mathrm{As}_2 \mathrm{~S}_3$ (-ve sol), mutual coagulation occurs which causes precipitation. No new compound is formed.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.q: Which of the following statements is incorrect about colloidal solution?
options: Lyophobic sols are more stable than lyophilic sols.
Lyophilic colloids have a unique property of protecting lyophobic colloids.
Lyophilic colloids are highly hydrated than lyophobic colloids.
None of these.
questions.solution: Lyophobic sols are unstable and are easily precipitated by addition of electrolytes. Lyophilic sols are quite stable and are not easily precipitated or coagulated.

emulsion

options: decreases in size
increase in size
decrease in charge
increase in charge

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.q: Which of the following is incorrect for physisorption?
options: Reversible
Increases with increase in temperature.
Low heat of adsorption.
Increases with increase in surface area.
questions.solution: Since, the adsorption process is exothermic, the physical adsorption occurs readily at low temperature and decreases with increase in temperature (Le-Chatelier's principle).

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.q: Correct equation of Freundlich isotherm is
options: \(\log \left(\frac{x}{m}\right)=\log k+\frac{1}{n} \log c\)
\(\log \left(\frac{x}{m}\right)=\log c+\frac{1}{n} \log k\)
\(\log \left(\frac{x}{m}\right)=\log c+\frac{1}{k} \log c\)
\(\log \left(\frac{x}{m}\right)=\log k+\frac{1}{k} \log c\)
questions.solution:
The empirical relation,
viz., $\frac{x}{m}=k c^{1 / n}$, put forward by Freundlich is known as Freundlich's adsorption isotherm. Taking $\log$ on both sides
$\log \left(\frac{x}{m}\right)=\log k+\frac{1}{n} \log c$

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.q:
Assertion : $\mathrm{Fe}^{3+}$ can be used for coagulation of $\mathrm{As}_2 \mathrm{~S}_3$ sol.
Reason : $\mathrm{Fe}^{3+}$ reacts with $\mathrm{As}_2 \mathrm{~S}_3$ to give $\mathrm{Fe}_2 \mathrm{~S}_3$.
options: If both assertion and reason are true and reason is the correct explanation of the assertion
If both assertion and reason are true but reason is not the correct explanation of the assertion
If assertion is true, but reason is false
Both assertion and reason are false statements.
questions.solution: When oppositely charged sols are mixed in almost equal proportions, their charges are neutralised. Both sols may be partially or completely precipitated. When negatively charged $\mathrm{As}_2 \mathrm{~S}_3$ sol is added to positively charged $\mathrm{Fe}(\mathrm{OH})_3$ sol, in suitable amounts, precipitation of both the sols take place simultaneously.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.q:
Assertion : Aqueous gold colloidal solution is red in colour.
Reason : The colour arises due to scattering of light by colloidal gold particles.
options: If both assertion and reason are true and reason is the correct explanation of assertion
If both assertion and reason are true but reason is not the correct explanation of assertion
If assertion is true but reason is false
If both assertion and reason are false.
questions.solution: The colour of colloidal solution depends on the wavelength of light scattered by the dispersed particles. The wavelength of light further depends on the size and nature of the particles. The colour of colloidal solution also changes with the way the observer receives the light. Finest gold sol is red in colour. As size of the particles increases, it becomes purple, then blue and finally golden yellow.

If both assertion and reason are true but reason is not the correct explanation of assertion
If assertion is true but reason is false
If both assertion and reason are false.
questions.solution: Zeolites are shape-selective porous solid acid catalysts, their catalytic activity originates from the presence of highly acidic $A 1-O(H)-$ Si hydroxyl in the framework.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.q:
Assertion : Activity of an enzyme is $\mathrm{pH}$ dependent.
Reason : Change in $\mathrm{pH}$ affects the solubility of the enzyme in water.
options: If both assertion and reason are true and the reason is the correct explanation of the assertion
If both assertion and reason are true and the reason is not the correct explanation of the assertion
If assertion is true but reason is false
If both assertion and reason are false.
questions.solution: Enzymes are proteins which act as catalyst for bio-chemical reactions. $\mathrm{pH}$ affect their activity as protonation-deprotonation may cause denaturation of the protein structure. Solubility is also affected.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.q:
Assertion : Haemoglobin is an oxygen carrier. 
Reason : Oxygen binds as $\mathrm{O}_2^{-}$to $\mathrm{Fe}$ of haemoglobin.
options: If both assertion and reason are true and the reason is the correct explanation of the assertion
If both assertion and reason are true and the reason is not the correct explanation of the assertion
If assertion is true but reason is false
If both assertion and reason are false.
questions.solution: Haemoglobin is the oxygen carrier in the human blood. It consists of four subunits and one molecule of haemoglobin can carry 4 molecules of $\mathrm{O}_2 . \mathrm{O}_2$ binds to $\mathrm{Fe}$ of heme part.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.q: Enzymes with two sites are called
options: apoenzyme
allosteric enzyme
holoenzyme
conjugate enzyme.
questions.solution: Enzymes with two active sites are called allosteric enzymes. One of these sites is the catalytic site for the concerned reaction. Other site may be the site for inhibition of catalysis by enzyme or to activate the enzyme further.

questions.solution: Micelle is formed if molecules with polar and non-polar ends assemble in bulk to give nonpolar interior and polar exterior.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.q: The size of colloidal particle is
questions.solution: A system is said to be in colloidal state if particles of one or more components have the same size range $10^{-6} \mathrm{~m}$ to $10^{-9} \mathrm{~m}$. In other words, the colloidal solution is a heterogenous dispersion of solute particles size ranging from $10^{-6} \mathrm{~m}$ into the solvent. Particles are visible only with an ultra microscope.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.q:
Assertion : Physical absorption of molecules takes place on surface only.
Reason : In this process, the bonds of the absorbed molecules are broken.
options: If both the assertion and reason are true and reason is a correct explanation of the assertion.
If both assertion and reason are true but assertion is not a correct explanation of the assertion.
If the assertion is true but the reason is false.
If both assertion and reason are false.
questions.solution: In physical absorption, the substance absorbed is retained not only on the surface but also more or less uniformly distributed throughout the entire body. And absorbed molecules are not broken under ordinary conditions.

options: If both assertion and reason are true and reason is the correct explanation of assertion.
Ifboth assertion and reason are true but reason is not the correct explanation of assertion.
If assertion is true but reason is false.
If both assertion and reason are false.
questions.solution: $\mathrm{Fe}^{3+}$ is positively charged whereas $\mathrm{As}_2 \mathrm{~S}_3$ is negatively charged sol. Their charges are neutralised on mixing hence, mutual precipitation (coagulation) occurs.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.q: A packet of colloidal system is taken in which colloidal particles are still. Two electrodes are taken in system and voltage is applied so that liquid medium moves under the influence of electric field. This phenomenon is called
options: electrodialysis
electroosmosis
electrophoresis
None of these.
questions.solution: Electroosmosis : When electrophoresis of dispersed particles in a colloidal system is presented by some suitable means, it is observed that the dispersion medium itself begins to move in an electric field. This phenomenon is called as electroosmosis.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.q:
Assertion : An increase in surface area increases the rate of evaporation.
Reason : Stronger the inter-molecular attractive forces, fast is the rate of evaporation at a given temperature.
options: If both the assertion and reason are true and reason is a correct explanation of the assertion.
If both assertion and reason are true but assertion is not a correct explanation of the assertion.
If the assertion is true but the reason is false.
If both assertion and reason are false.
questions.solution: More is the surface area, fast is the rate of evaporation at a given temperature this is due to the fact that more surface area means more number of molecules at the surface which can then be evaporated easily. Strong inter-molecular forces of attraction slows down the rate of evaporation.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.q: A catalyst
options: changes the equilibrium constant
lowers the activation energy
increases the forward and backward reactions at different speeds
follows same mechanism for the reaction.
questions.solution: A substance which increases the speed of a reaction without being consumed in the reaction is called a catalyst. Catalyst reduces the height of barrier by providing an alternative path for the reaction and lowers the activation energy.
